parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. Matched by fuzzy match.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the type definition. Matched by plain text containment.

parameters.name: Extend
parameters.description:
The extension mode filter. Valid values:

- NONE: custom entity only.
- TABLE: extension table entity.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Valid values:

- Asc: ascending order.
- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- Name: sorted by name.
- CreateTime: sorted by creation time.
- ModifyTime: sorted by modification time.
